shared_elements: low-relief profile figures with human bodies
bearded/patterned hair and beard treatment rendered in rows of curls
raised arm with hand held forward
horizontal register borders framing the scene
justification: Both depict profile low-relief anthropomorphic figures in long fringed robes, striding with one arm raised and the other holding a small vessel-like object, with rosette/floral ornament and a framing register line — a fairly specific conventional scheme of the offering/attendant figure. The main difference is that A shows a continuous procession of several fully human, crowned figures interacting with one another, whereas B shows a single large bird-headed winged being flanked by stylised plants beneath a block of inscription.
